name: Kuber Udyog Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1982, Kuber Udyog Ltd is engaged in NBFC(Non-Deposit taking) activities.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
KUL was in the business as a non-banking financial company, but it applied for surrendering of its NBFC Licence as it is not accepting any Public Deposits, nor is it planning to accept the same in the future. Currently, the co. has started catering to the various clients by providing:
a) Advisory IT services
b) Consulting on banking regulatory matters
c) Consulting on non-fund-based banking services
e) Consulting on bank relationship management 
f) Trading in DEPB Licences

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -12.7% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 1.73% over last 3 years.
